npc.name: Rin
npc.dialogue: I heard Sequoia gave you your partner. Mine is ready too! I'm not letting you reach Verdant Gym without a challenge.
npc.followup: Let's meet again on the road. Our Pokémon will grow stronger together.

npc.name: Warden Elowen
npc.dialogue: Thorn asked me to check the forest after your Verdant victory. The Pokémon here are restless, and glowing fragments appeared after the storm.
npc.followup: Take note of their shape. The Meridian Institute says it's ordinary mineral drift, but I am not convinced.

npc.name: Miner Lyra
npc.dialogue: Rook's Bastion trial proved you can handle yourself. Someone removed the oldest survey pages from our mine archive.
npc.followup: See these marks? Eclipse was here, but the equipment on the wagon belongs to Meridian.

npc.name: Eclipse Scout
npc.dialogue: You think we stole the surveys for profit? Meridian hides what it mines. If you care about Pokémon, question the company behind the badges.
npc.followup: I'm not asking you to trust Eclipse. I'm asking you to look closer.

npc.name: Rin
npc.dialogue: You're following Eclipse rumors? Maybe. But we need evidence before accusing anyone.
npc.followup: I'll keep investigating the south road. Whoever finds the truth first buys the other a meal.

npc.name: Technician Sol
npc.dialogue: Ashen helped stop the overheating near the foundry, but the instruments are still reading impossible temperatures.
npc.followup: The power isn't rising from the earth. Something is feeding it into the station.

npc.name: Researcher Vela
npc.dialogue: Our institute studies Resonance to keep people and Pokémon safe. I joined Meridian because our work could save endangered habitats.
npc.followup: Still, some files have been sealed beyond even my authorization. I hope there's a harmless reason.

npc.name: Keeper Neris
npc.dialogue: Kai's Tidal Badge means you understand the waterways. The river was poisoned by a timed energy pulse, not an ordinary spill.
npc.followup: Eclipse arrived later, so they could not have caused the first event. We need to tell the Rangers.

npc.name: Captain Rowan
npc.dialogue: The Pride Rangers protect Pokémon no matter which faction profits from a disaster. Thank you for bringing us evidence.
npc.followup: We'll open an independent case. Keep exploring freely, but don't face the institute's security teams alone.

npc.name: Engineer Quill
npc.dialogue: Vega's city kept the grid stable. Beneath the power station is a second circuit no one told the League about.
npc.followup: Every wire converges at a sealed Meridian facility. They're building something called the Resonance Engine.

npc.name: Aide Iris
npc.dialogue: Director Cael insists the engine will heal the region. He might believe it. But the risk reports are missing from the public archive.
npc.followup: I can show you where the older research records were taken. Use them responsibly.

npc.name: Historian Toren
npc.dialogue: Draven's Dragon trial echoes an old oath: power is guarded, not owned. Our ancestors sealed Resonance conduits after a terrible flood.
npc.followup: You found the new circuit. Now seek the cold station where the earliest warning was recorded.

npc.name: Archivist Sera
npc.dialogue: Freya kept these records hidden beneath the snow. Meridian knew the engine could frighten and displace whole Pokémon habitats.
npc.followup: A researcher tried to shut it down and vanished from the project. Her signature is on every safety warning.

npc.name: Rin
npc.dialogue: We kept competing while the region changed around us. I thought becoming Champion was the biggest thing we could do.
npc.followup: I was wrong. Whatever comes next, you won't face it alone.

npc.name: Medium Ori
npc.dialogue: Nyx's Ghost trial taught you that memories leave traces. The echoes here show Eclipse's raid and Meridian's experiment were both dangerous.
npc.followup: Eclipse plans to destroy the engine. A sudden shutdown could unleash every stored pulse at once.

npc.name: Eclipse Lieutenant
npc.dialogue: Sable has ordered the assault. We were told there was no other way to stop Meridian.
npc.followup: If you truly have proof, take it to the leader. Perhaps the region doesn't need another disaster to learn the truth.

npc.name: Sable
npc.dialogue: I founded Eclipse after Meridian buried our reports. I was right about their experiments, but my people endangered Pokémon to expose them.
npc.followup: If the engine explodes, none of that will matter. Find Cael and force him to face the truth.

npc.name: Director Cael
npc.dialogue: Resonance could restore entire ecosystems. Every great discovery demands courage, even when our models show uncertainty.
npc.followup: You bring evidence I cannot dismiss. I will authorize a shutdown review, but stabilizing the engine requires real action, not words.

npc.name: Captain Rowan
npc.dialogue: You've uncovered the heart of the crisis. The Rangers will coordinate a stabilization mission with trusted researchers and Rin.
npc.followup: Your briefing is complete. The final engine operation requires its own battle and world objectives before we can call the region safe.

npc.name: League Guide
npc.dialogue: The road to Magnus remains open to Trainers who have earned all eight badges. Victory Road will test everything you've learned.
npc.followup: Your investigation doesn't award badges. Your battles and the League alone decide who becomes Champion.

npc.name: Hall of Fame Keeper
npc.dialogue: Magnus recognizes your victories, and the Hall of Fame now records your name. Your adventure did not end when you became Champion.
npc.followup: Pride Region is full of expeditions, research, competitive battles and friendships yet to come.
